Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server (public preview) available in new regions

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server (in preview) is now available in the Australia East and Canada Central regions. Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server is a new deployment option for Azure Database for PostgreSQL that gives you the control you need with multiple configuration parameters for fine-grained database tuning along with a simpler developer experience to accelerate end-to-end deployment.

Learn about current supported regions for Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server in preview and read our documentation.
